meta.title: Enhance prompt
meta.description: Adds a sparkle icon button labelled “Enhance prompt” to the composer toolbar, immediately to the left of the model selector. Clicking it sends only the typed text of the draft to the configured model, which rewrites it into a clear, sectioned prompt (plain-text section labels with a colon, lists, blank lines between sections; no '#' or bold). Uploaded images and files, and inline references (for example @file), are preserved: references round-trip as opaque markers and are rebuilt as their original chips, and image/file attachments are re-checked and restored after writeback, so they never disappear or turn into plain-text paths. An Undo action in the status note restores the exact original draft including files and references. No request is made for an empty draft, a draft containing only files, command mode, an unsupported draft shape, or a non-editable input state; a spinner shows progress, clicking again cancels, and timeouts, model failures, over-long drafts, a missing model and a model that dropped a file marker each report their own message. Enhancement makes one extra model request and sends the draft text (not file contents) to the currently configured model provider. It writes nothing to the session log and does not activate an Agent. If the draft changes while a request is in flight, the plugin does not overwrite it. Disabling the plugin removes the button and leaves existing drafts untouched.
